headline: Canadian online broker Questrade allows AI assistants to place trades, Money.ca reports.
score_reason: Pool score lowered one point: only the headline could be checked, and it is unclear what is new on 10 Oct beyond Questrade's July 2026 AI-assistant launch.
importance_line: Questrade clients could have AI assistants place trades in their accounts, putting real money under AI control, but the safeguards, trade limits and start date are not known.
summary: Money.ca reports that Questrade, a Toronto-based online brokerage, allows AI assistants to carry out trades.
notes: Headline only: Money.ca blocked (HTTP 403) and no other outlet covers this article. Related background from Wealth Professional (read): Questrade launched Questrade MCP, linking client accounts to AI assistants such as Claude and ChatGPT, on or about 30 Jul 2026, so whether 10 Oct is a new step or a repeat of that launch is unverified; freshness left NEW for that reason. 'Toronto-based' comes from the Wealth Professional article.
